answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 12 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The tide chain is verified at intake and echo publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 12 epochs old, anchored at a karst checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 358 aliases cost 331 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
